description:
List the time blocks of a day's timeline (Day view), in timeline order. A block is either an activity (type 'block') or a task bucket (type 'tasks' — groups the day's untimed tasks). The meta carries the day's raw timeline_order: "b:<uuid>" refs are blocks, bare uuids are tasks inside a bucket's run.

Recurring blocks: listing today or a future day first creates that day's recurring blocks if they do not exist yet (same as opening the day in the app), so every block returned has a real id you can update or mark done. A block that repeats carries `repeats: { recurring_block_id, weekdays }` (ISO weekdays, 1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday); otherwise `repeats` is null. Past days are never filled in afterwards.
name: list_day_blocks
